steps.name: Environment setup and persistent Streamlit defaults
steps.description: Ensure python3-pip available, create/backup /etc/profile.d/streamlit.sh with conservative Streamlit defaults (STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS=true and STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0). Add a timestamped header to the profile and only replace when content differs. Validate pip availability using the system python. This step is idempotent and minimally intrusive.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/streamlit.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
cat >"$TMP" <<'EOF'
# Streamlit environment defaults persisted by setup (created: %TIMESTAMP%)
# Managed by setup script; safe defaults for interactive shells
export STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS="true"
export STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS="0.0.0.0"
# Note: STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT is intentionally NOT set here to avoid orchestrator conflicts
EOF
# replace placeholder timestamp
sed -i "s|%TIMESTAMP%|$TS|g" "$TMP"
# Ensure python3-pip present (image typically has it). If missing, install (allow apt errors to surface).
if ! python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-pip
fi
# Backup existing profile if present and only replace when content differs
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE"; then
  sudo cp -a "$PROFILE" "$PROFILE.bak.$TS" || true
fi
if ! sudo sh -c "cmp -s '$TMP' '$PROFILE' 2>/dev/null"; then
  sudo install -m 644 "$TMP" "$PROFILE"
fi
rm -f "$TMP"
# Quick sanity: ensure pip accessible
python3 -m pip --version

steps.name: Project scaffolding and workspace preparation
steps.description: Create the workspace directory, set ownership to the current user, create a safe ASCII placeholder app if no app.py/main.py exists (and emit a NOTICE file with a stable marker string). Normalize requirements.txt by removing blank/comment-only lines, trimming whitespace, deduplicating while preserving order, and ensuring 'streamlit' is present. Detect PDF library references and create a NOTICE (do not modify requirements on PDF libs). Avoid over-permissive chmod; set conservative permissions for developer use.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure workspace owned by current user and conservative permissions
sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE" || true
chmod -R u+rwX,g+rwX,o-rwx "$WORKSPACE" || true
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Create safe ASCII placeholder and NOTICE marker if no app present
PLACEHOLDER_MSG="PLACEHOLDER_BY_SETUP_SCRIPT_v1"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/app.py" ] && [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/main.py" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/app.py" <<'PY'
# Placeholder Streamlit app - safe until dependencies are installed
# NOTICE_MARKER: PLACEHOLDER_BY_SETUP_SCRIPT_v1

def get_message():
    return 'Placeholder app created by setup script. Install dependencies and replace this file.'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(get_message())
PY
  printf "Created placeholder app.py with NOTICE_MARKER: %s\n" "$PLACEHOLDER_MSG" > NOTICE_PLACEHOLDER.txt
fi
# Normalize requirements.txt: strip comments/blanks, trim whitespace, preserve full lines and order, dedupe
REQ="$WORKSPACE/requirements.txt"
if [ ! -f "$REQ" ]; then
  touch "$REQ"
fi
awk 'BEGIN{seen_count=0} {g=$0; sub(/^[ \t]+/,"",g); sub(/[ \t]+$/,"",g); if(g=="" || g~"^#") next; if(!seen[g]++){print g}}' "$REQ" > "$REQ.normalized" || true
# Ensure streamlit present
if ! grep -Eqi '^\s*streamlit(\b|[=<>])' "$REQ.normalized"; then
  printf "streamlit\n" >> "$REQ.normalized"
fi
mv "$REQ.normalized" "$REQ"
# Heuristic: detect PDF libs and notify
if grep -Eri "reportlab|weasyprint" . -n --exclude-dir=.venv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf "Detected references to reportlab/weasyprint. If PDF generation is required, add reportlab or weasyprint to requirements.txt with versions.\n" > NOTICE_pdf_libs.txt
fi

steps.name: Install Python dependencies into workspace venv and validate
steps.description: Create a workspace-local Python venv (if missing), explicitly use the venv python for all pip operations, install packages from requirements.txt, and install pytest into the venv. Upgrade pip/setuptools but show output on failure, report pip and streamlit versions after install, and fail with clear exit codes on install errors. This step avoids modifying global Python and is idempotent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
REQ="$WORKSPACE/requirements.txt"
# Create venv if missing
if [ ! -d "$VENV" ]; then
  python3 -m venv "$VENV"
fi
# Use explicit venv python for determinism
PY="$VENV/bin/python"
PIP="$VENV/bin/python -m pip"
# Upgrade pip/setuptools and show output on failure
$PIP install --upgrade pip setuptools || { echo 'pip/setuptools upgrade failed' >&2; $PIP --version >&2 || true; exit 6; }
# Install from requirements if present
if [ -f "$REQ" ] && [ -s "$REQ" ]; then
  $PIP install -r "$REQ" || { echo 'pip install -r requirements.txt failed' >&2; $PIP --version >&2 || true; $VENV/bin/pip list --format=columns >&2 || true; exit 4; }
fi
# Ensure pytest installed
$PIP install pytest || { echo 'pip install pytest failed' >&2; exit 5; }
# Report versions for diagnostics
$VENV/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sys, pkgutil
print('python_executable:' + sys.executable)
try:
  import pip
  print('pip_version:' + pip.__version__)
except Exception:
  pass
try:
  import streamlit as s
  print('streamlit_version:' + s.__version__)
except Exception:
  print('streamlit_not_importable')
PY
# Validate streamlit import explicitly (fail if not importable)
$VENV/bin/python - <<'PY'
import importlib,sys
try:
  importlib.import_module('streamlit')
except Exception as e:
  print('streamlit import failed: ' + str(e))
  sys.exit(2)
PY

steps.name: Testing setup and run meaningful pytest
steps.description: Create a minimal pytest that attempts to import the app safely. If the app file contains unsafe patterns the test will be skipped (pytest.skip) to surface skipped state rather than silently succeeding; real import exceptions will fail the test. Run pytest from the workspace venv to validate the test infra.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
# Use explicit venv python
PY="$VENV/bin/python"
mkdir -p tests
TESTFILE=tests/test_import_app.py
cat > "$TESTFILE" <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import os
import pytest

ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..'))

def safe_load(path):
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        src = f.read()
    # If placeholder marker present, skip
    if 'NOTICE_MARKER: PLACEHOLDER_BY_SETUP_SCRIPT_v1' in src:
        pytest.skip('Placeholder app present; skipping import test')
    # Heuristic: if file contains "if __name__" treat as potentially executing; skip
    if 'if __name__' in src:
        pytest.skip('Top-level __main__ detected; skipping import to avoid side-effects')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('proj_app', path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
        return True
    except Exception:
        # allow actual import errors to fail the test
        raise


def test_import_app():
    for candidate in ('app.py', 'main.py'):
        p = os.path.join(ROOT, candidate)
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            safe_load(p)
            return
    # fallback: ensure requirements mention streamlit
    req = os.path.join(ROOT, 'requirements.txt')
    assert os.path.isfile(req)
    txt = open(req, 'r', encoding='utf-8').read().lower()
    assert 'streamlit' in txt
PY
# Run pytest via venv python
$VENV/bin/python -m pytest -q || { echo 'pytest failed' >&2; exit 2; }

steps.name: Validation: start Streamlit in isolated session, smoke test HTTP, and stop cleanly
steps.description: Start Streamlit using the workspace venv in a new session (setsid) to ensure an isolated process group, probe HTTP for 2xx/3xx and verify response contains a Streamlit marker to avoid false negatives, then perform group termination using PGID (kill -TERM -$PGID) and provide logs on failure. Skip full HTTP validation when the placeholder marker is present. This step depends on all prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
PORT=${PORT:-8501}
LOG=/tmp/streamlit."$$".log
# Use explicit venv python
PY="$VENV/bin/python"
# Quick checks
if [ ! -d "$VENV" ]; then
  echo 'validation: venv missing' >&2
  exit 2
fi
if grep -Fq "NOTICE_MARKER: PLACEHOLDER_BY_SETUP_SCRIPT_v1" app.py 2>/dev/null || [ ! -f app.py ]; then
  echo 'validation: placeholder app detected or app.py missing; skipping full HTTP validation' >&2
  exit 0
fi
# Start streamlit in a new session (setsid) so it has its own PGID
SETSID_CMD="setsid env STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS=true STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT=${PORT} $VENV/bin/python -m streamlit run app.py --server.port ${PORT} --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true"
# Launch and capture PID
sh -c "$SETSID_CMD" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
ST_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
# Derive PGID for group termination
ST_PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $ST_PID 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || echo "")
# Wait up to 60s for HTTP 2xx or 3xx and check body for 'streamlit' marker
SECS=0
MAX=60
OK=0
while [ $SECS -lt $MAX ]; do
  HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/streamlit_resp.$$ -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ || echo "000")
  if echo "$HTTP_CODE" | grep -Eq '^[23]'; then
    # check response body for a Streamlit marker to reduce false positives
    if grep -qi 'streamlit' /tmp/streamlit_resp.$$ 2>/dev/null; then
      OK=1
      break
    fi
  fi
  sleep 1; SECS=$((SECS+1))
done
rm -f /tmp/streamlit_resp.$$ || true
if [ "$OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "validation: server responded successfully (pid=$ST_PID, pgid=$ST_PGID)"
  # attempt graceful group shutdown
  if [ -n "$ST_PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$ST_PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else
    pkill -P $ST_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    kill $ST_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  # wait briefly
  sleep 2
  # final cleanup
  if [ -n "$ST_PGID" ]; then
    kill -KILL -"$ST_PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  exit 0
else
  echo "validation: server did not respond with 2xx/3xx and Streamlit marker within ${MAX}s; last log lines:" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true
  # attempt cleanup
  if [ -n "$ST_PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$ST_PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 1
    kill -KILL -"$ST_PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else
    pkill -P $ST_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    kill $ST_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  exit 3
fi
